verdicts.reason: Both break the search-bar concept the same way: the white pill sits empty at the top with no search icon, and the headline is pulled out of it. Both CTA buttons are shrunk until the text can't be read, the laptops and camera are gone, leaving a cropped glasses fragment and a stray black ring, and both have dead gray space between the subcopy and the CTA. B's headline is larger and 'identity' nearly touches the right edge; A keeps slightly better side margins, so it is marginally less broken.
